page_title: TOU 0-2 LEN | Toulouse v Lens 28/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Toulouse.
90+5' Toulouse hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
90+1' Florian Sotoca (Lens) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' Substitution. Ruben Aguilar will be replaced by Salis Abdul Samed (Lens).
88' It will be a substitution. Ayanda Sishuba (Lens) is ready to enter the pitch as Elye Wahi walks off.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Adrien Thomasson (Lens) is coming onto the pitch as David Costa cannot continue after picking up an injury.
88' Carles Martinez has decided to make a change. Ibrahim Cissoko (Toulouse) replaces Aron Donnum.
88' The referee signals a substitution. Cesar Gelabert Pina (Toulouse) is brought on as a substitute for Niklas Schmidt.
87' A cross from a corner kick by Toulouse is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
85' Mikkel Desler (Toulouse) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his low effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
85' Toulouse force their opponents to concede a corner.
84' Toulouse failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
84' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) fails to score from the penalty spot! His effort only crashes against the crossbar.
84' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
83' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Massadio Haidara (Lens) was quite harsh and Mathieu Vernice didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
83' It’s a PENALTY to Toulouse after the VAR review!
82' There's a break in play and referee Mathieu Vernice must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Toulouse using VAR. This could be interesting!

81' Brice Samba pulls off a glorious save! Mikkel Desler (Toulouse) attempts to head home after a precise lofted cross. However, his effort only finds its way into the goalkeeper gloves. Toulouse force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
80' The referee blows his whistle as Massadio Haidara (Lens) was too aggressive in his challenge.
78' Mikkel Desler (Toulouse) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
74' David Costa (Lens) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Mathieu Vernice no option but to blow his whistle.
73' David Costa (Lens) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
71' We are about to witness a subsitution. Mikkel Desler (Toulouse) for Warren Kamanzi.
70' Here is a change. Jhoanner Chavez is going off and Franck Haise gives the last tactical orders to Massadio Haidara (Lens).
70' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Wesley Said.

68' Toulouse are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
66' Toulouse take a short corner kick.
65' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Toulouse.
63' The resulting set piece from Toulouse is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
62' Carles Martinez has decided to substitute Shavy Babicka and he is replaced by Yann Gboho (Toulouse).
62' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Cristian Casseres walks off the pitch to be replaced by Naatan Skytta (Toulouse).
60' Lens are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.

55' 0 - 2 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Andy Diouf (Lens) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a magnificent shot into the top left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Guillaume Restes, so the score changes to 0:2.
55' David Costa (Lens) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
51' Rough tackle by Wesley Said (Lens). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Lens concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
49' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) has tested the patience of referee Mathieu Vernice and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
48' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:3.
46' One of the players from Toulouse times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+2' A brilliant individual effort! Elye Wahi (Lens) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
45+1' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Lens was in an offside position.
45' What was Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
42' 0 - 1 David Costa (Lens) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom right corner. Magnificent finish!
41' Lens can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
40' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
40' The referee signals a corner kick to Lens.
38' Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
36' Wesley Said (Lens) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mathieu Vernice had an easy-decision to make.
33' Elye Wahi (Lens) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
30' The Lens players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
27' Mathieu Vernice interrupts the game. One of the players from Toulouse won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
26' Mathieu Vernice interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Wesley Said (Lens).
25' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) connects with the corner but his looping header goes well over. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
24' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lens.
23' Mathieu Vernice couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Wesley Said (Lens) and blew his whistle.
18' Lens keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
14' Toulouse have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

14' Andy Diouf (Lens) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
11' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) was too forceful with his tackle and Mathieu Vernice interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
10' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Toulouse comes to nothing.
8' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Toulouse take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
3' The corner is swung in but Lens can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

3' Florian Sotoca (Lens) wins himself just enough space to meet the corner and shoots. The shot goes towards the bottom right corner, but Guillaume Restes makes a decent save and thwarts the effort. The referee blows his whistle, Lens are awarded a corner kick.
2' The ball is out of play. Lens win a corner kick.
2' Lens seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Lens will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Mathieu Vernice.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
